items.title: Keralam government sanctions ₹11 crore for road development in Kochi
items.text: The project aims to improve the motorability of the road and address hardships faced by commuters, says Ernakulam MLA

items.title: Himachal approves ₹1,500 monthly financial assistance for women
items.text: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiary families will also receive 300 units of free electricity

items.title: Microsoft Outage updates: No ETA yet on full recovery, company says
items.text: Microsoft services are beginning to come back online after a massive global outage left millions of users without access for nearly 18 hours

items.title: Stock markets snap three-day rally on rate hike fears; Sensex drops 318 points
items.text: Retail inflation surged to 6.09% in October, breaching the RBI’s upper tolerance limit for the first time in two years and prompting expectations of a rate hike next month

items.title: Oil India on track for 4 MMT crude oil production this fiscal, officials state
items.text: Oil India further stated that it was on track for scaling their capex target of ₹7,500 crore.
